card.name: Gurage dance
card.tagline: Acrobatic, full-body dance of Ethiopia's Gurage
card.profile: The Gurage dance (Guragigna) is the energetic traditional dance of the Gurage people of south-central Ethiopia. Per the Mocha Ethiopia Dance Group and Universal Tongue, it is fast-paced and athletic, demanding full-body coordination as dancers move arms and legs forward and back while jumping on alternate legs - reflecting the Gurage's reputation as hard workers; women dance in trousers with hair covered for the rapid tempo. It accompanies weddings, religious festivities and community gatherings, with music on masenqo and kebero.
card.insight: Guragigna is among Ethiopia's most acrobatic regional dances and a vibrant marker of Gurage identity within the country's mosaic of more than 80 ethnic dance traditions (Mocha Ethiopia Dance Group; Universal Tongue).
